name: Stable Diffusion WebUI
description: Open source browser interface for running Stable Diffusion models entirely on your own GPU.
long_description: AUTOMATIC1111's WebUI is the most widely used local interface for Stable Diffusion, with inpainting, upscaling, ControlNet and a large extension ecosystem. Once installed, generation is unlimited and costs nothing beyond electricity.
free_access_summary: Free and open source; unlimited generation on your own hardware.
best_for: Full control over models and styles
not_ideal_for: Machines without a capable GPU
Users who want zero setup

free_access.description: Open source and unlimited once installed.

name: ComfyUI
description: Open source visual graph editor for building reproducible image and video generation workflows.
long_description: ComfyUI represents generation as a node graph, which makes complex pipelines explicit, shareable and reproducible. It runs locally, supports most open image and video models, and workflows can be exported as JSON.
free_access_summary: Free and open source; runs locally with no usage limits.
not_ideal_for: Users who just want one image quickly

free_access.description: Free and open source.
restrictions: Steeper learning curve than simple prompt boxes

name: Midjourney
description: Subscription image generator known for strong aesthetics. There is no free tier.
long_description: Midjourney produces some of the most visually polished output available and runs through Discord and its web app. Free trials were discontinued, so a paid plan is required from the start - a clear example of a paid-only tool.
free_access_summary: No free tier. A paid subscription is required to generate images.
best_for: Teams that prioritise output quality over cost
not_ideal_for: Anyone needing a free option
Automated pipelines needing an official API

name: Leonardo AI
tagline: Image generation with daily free tokens
description: Image and asset generator that refills a free token allowance every day.
long_description: Leonardo offers fine-tuned models, canvas editing and 3D texture generation, with a daily token grant on the free plan that resets automatically - useful for steady low-volume work without a subscription.
free_access_summary: Free plan with a daily token allowance that resets each day.
pricing_summary: Paid plans add larger token grants and private generations. Check the official pricing page for current rates.
best_for: Regular small volumes of images at no cost
not_ideal_for: High-volume batch generation on the free plan

free_access.description: Daily token allowance that resets every 24 hours.
restrictions: Generations are public on the free plan

name: Ideogram
description: Generator known for rendering legible text inside images, with a free daily allowance.
long_description: Ideogram is unusually reliable at typography inside generated images, which makes it practical for logos, posters and UI mockups. The free plan includes a daily set of slow generations.
free_access_summary: Free plan with a daily allowance of slow generations.
not_ideal_for: Fast turnaround on the free plan

free_access.description: Daily free generations in slow mode.
restrictions: Slow queue on the free plan

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Image, video and audio generation trained on licensed content, with monthly free credits.
long_description: Firefly is designed for commercial use, with training data Adobe licenses, and integrates into Photoshop and Express. Free accounts receive a monthly generative credit allowance.
free_access_summary: Monthly generative credits on a free Adobe account.
pricing_summary: Paid Firefly and Creative Cloud plans add more credits. Check the official pricing page for current rates.
best_for: Work that needs clear commercial licensing
not_ideal_for: High volume generation without a paid plan

free_access.description: Free monthly generative credits.

name: Krea
description: Canvas tool that generates and enhances images live as you draw or type.
long_description: Krea provides real-time generation, upscaling and video tools in a single canvas, aggregating multiple underlying models. A free tier gives daily credits at lower priority.
free_access_summary: Free tier with daily credits at lower priority.
not_ideal_for: Users needing guaranteed fast queues for free

free_access.description: Daily free credits.

name: Clipdrop
description: Focused image editing utilities: background removal, cleanup, upscaling and relighting.
long_description: Clipdrop packages single-purpose image tools that each do one job well, available in the browser and via API. A free tier covers occasional use at reduced resolution.
free_access_summary: Free tier with limited daily operations and reduced output resolution.
not_ideal_for: High-resolution output on the free tier

free_access.description: Limited free operations each day.

name: FLUX
description: Image model family from Black Forest Labs with open weights you can run yourself.
long_description: FLUX models are available in open weight variants that can run locally or through hosted APIs. The open variants make high quality generation possible without per-image fees if you have the hardware.
free_access_summary: Open weight variants are free to download and run locally; hosted API usage is metered.
best_for: Developers integrating image generation into products
not_ideal_for: Users without GPU access who want free generation

free_access.description: Open weight model variants can be downloaded and run for free.

name: Recraft
description: Generates editable vector graphics, icons and consistent brand styles.
long_description: Recraft is unusual in producing true SVG output rather than raster images, which matters for icons, logos and UI assets. A free tier provides a daily credit allowance.
free_access_summary: Free tier with daily credits; outputs are public on the free plan.
not_ideal_for: Photorealistic imagery

free_access.description: Daily free credit allowance.
restrictions: Generations are public on the free plan

name: Runway
description: Video generation, in-painting and editing tools used in professional production.
long_description: Runway offers text and image to video generation alongside editing tools like background removal and motion brush. New accounts receive a one-off credit allowance to try generation.
free_access_summary: One-off free credits on signup; credits do not renew on the free plan.
not_ideal_for: Ongoing free usage - credits are one-off

free_access.description: One-time credit grant when you create an account.
restrictions: Watermarked output on the free plan

name: Luma Dream Machine
description: Video generation model with a free tier that refreshes monthly.
long_description: Dream Machine generates short video clips from text or a starting image, with camera motion control and keyframe support. The free plan includes a small monthly generation allowance.
free_access_summary: Free plan with a small monthly allowance of video generations.
not_ideal_for: Long-form video production

free_access.description: Monthly free generation allowance.

name: Kling AI
description: Video model offering a daily free credit grant, useful for regular experimentation.
long_description: Kling generates video from text or images with strong motion coherence, and grants free credits daily rather than once, which suits ongoing low-volume use.
free_access_summary: Daily free credit grant that refreshes every day.
not_ideal_for: Guaranteed fast generation without a paid plan

free_access.description: Daily credit grant that resets automatically.
restrictions: Standard mode only on free credits

name: HeyGen
description: Generates presenter-style videos from a script with avatars and translated voice-overs.
long_description: HeyGen creates talking-head videos from text, including avatar creation and video translation with lip sync. A free plan allows a few short videos per month with a watermark.
free_access_summary: Free plan with a small number of short, watermarked videos per month.
not_ideal_for: Watermark-free output on the free plan

free_access.description: A few short videos each month.

name: Descript
description: Transcribes video and audio so you can cut them by deleting words in a document.
long_description: Descript turns recordings into an editable transcript: removing a sentence removes it from the video. It also handles filler-word removal, studio sound and voice cloning. A free plan covers a limited number of transcription hours.
free_access_summary: Free plan with a limited monthly transcription allowance and watermarked exports.
not_ideal_for: Frame-accurate cinematic editing

free_access.description: Limited transcription hours per month on the free plan.

name: ElevenLabs
description: High quality speech synthesis, voice cloning and dubbing with a free monthly character allowance.
long_description: ElevenLabs is widely used for natural sounding narration, with multilingual voices, cloning and an API that developers can call directly. The free tier grants a monthly character quota.
free_access_summary: Free tier with a monthly character allowance and attribution requirements.
not_ideal_for: Commercial use without attribution on the free tier

free_access.description: Monthly free character allowance including API access.
restrictions: Attribution required on the free tier

name: Whisper
description: OpenAI's open source transcription model that runs locally in many languages.
long_description: Whisper is MIT licensed and can be run on your own machine, with community ports like whisper.cpp making CPU transcription practical. It is the default choice for free, private transcription at any volume.
free_access_summary: MIT licensed and free to run locally with no usage limits.
not_ideal_for: Real-time transcription on low-powered hardware

free_access.description: Free and open source, unlimited local use.
restrictions: Hosted API usage is billed separately

name: Piper
description: Open source neural TTS that runs on modest hardware, including a Raspberry Pi.
long_description: Piper produces natural speech locally with low latency and small models, which makes it a practical free option for offline voice output in applications and assistants.
free_access_summary: Open source and free; runs entirely offline.
not_ideal_for: Studio-grade voice cloning

free_access.description: Free and open source.
restrictions: Voice quality below commercial cloud services

name: Suno
description: Creates complete songs with vocals and instrumentation, with free daily credits.
long_description: Suno generates full tracks including lyrics and vocals from a text description. The free plan grants daily credits, though free-tier output is limited to non-commercial use.
free_access_summary: Free daily credits; free-tier output is non-commercial.
best_for: Background music for demos and videos
not_ideal_for: Commercial release from the free tier

free_access.description: Daily credit grant on the free plan.

name: Udio
description: Music generation with fine control over structure and style, on a monthly free allowance.
long_description: Udio focuses on musical control - sections, extensions and remixing - and offers a monthly free generation allowance for personal use.
free_access_summary: Free monthly generation allowance for personal use.
not_ideal_for: Commercial licensing on the free plan

free_access.description: Monthly free generation allowance.
restrictions: Personal use only on the free tier

name: v0
tagline: Generate React UI from a prompt
description: Vercel's UI generator producing React and Tailwind components you can paste into a project.
long_description: v0 turns descriptions or screenshots into React components using Tailwind and shadcn/ui, with an iterative chat to refine the result and one-click deployment to Vercel. A free tier includes monthly credits.
free_access_summary: Free plan with a monthly credit allowance.
not_ideal_for: Non-React frameworks

free_access.description: Monthly free credit allowance.

name: Figma
description: Industry-standard interface design tool with AI features and a free starter plan.
long_description: Figma covers UI design, prototyping and developer handoff, with AI features for generating first drafts, renaming layers and searching designs. The free Starter plan supports a limited number of files.
free_access_summary: Free Starter plan with a limited number of design files and collaborators.
pricing_summary: Paid seats are billed per editor. Check the official pricing page for current rates.
best_for: Feeding real designs to coding agents
not_ideal_for: Teams needing many editors on the free plan

free_access.description: Starter plan with a limited number of files and pages.

name: Canva
description: Template-driven design suite with AI generation and a free plan that covers most basics.
long_description: Canva handles slides, diagrams, social images and documents with a large template library, plus Magic Studio AI features. The free plan is genuinely usable for most everyday design work.
free_access_summary: Free plan with most editing features and a limited allowance of AI generations.
not_ideal_for: Precise product interface design

free_access.description: Free plan with limited monthly AI generations and premium assets excluded.
restrictions: Premium templates and assets are paid

name: Gamma
description: Creates decks, documents and simple sites from an outline, with free starting credits.
long_description: Gamma produces presentations that adapt to content rather than fixed slide templates, and can turn a prompt or pasted notes into a full deck. New accounts receive a one-off credit grant.
free_access_summary: One-off credit grant on signup; free decks carry Gamma branding.
not_ideal_for: Heavily branded corporate decks on the free plan

free_access.description: One-time credit grant for new accounts.

name: Grammarly
description: Grammar, clarity and tone suggestions across the browser and desktop, with a solid free tier.
long_description: Grammarly checks correctness and clarity everywhere you write, including pull request descriptions, documentation and email. The free tier covers grammar and basic clarity suggestions.
free_access_summary: Free plan with grammar and basic clarity suggestions plus limited AI prompts.
not_ideal_for: Long-form generation - it is an editor, not a writer

free_access.description: Free plan with unlimited basic corrections and a limited number of AI prompts.
restrictions: Advanced rewriting requires a paid plan
